notes: Every exercise now shows a NEXT target from your own last session: +1 rep at the same load, or a ~2.5% load step
The target is built from your best set by estimated 1RM, so a light warmup triple never sets it
Load steps snap to what you can actually load (multiples of 1.25 kg)
Fix: weights keep their decimals everywhere - 102.5 kg was being displayed as 103
Fix: workouts and the bodyweight log are date-ordered on load, so the comparison can no longer read the wrong pair of sessions
Includes 1.0.6: rest between sets, which feeds Stamina only
